message: 空に星と願いが駆ける

name: Amyrina
message: 「About one month has passed since we came to the Human World--」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Say, Lolotte. Unlike Heaven, time seems to pass quickly in the Human World, doesn't it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It actually does seem to be different. Remember how you mentioned it before, Amyrina?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes. I had thought it was roughly a week since you headed to the Human World, Lolotte, but...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It turned out that over ten months had passed in the Human World, after all.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「However, don't you think that's far too hectic?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not at all! Busy days are much more fulfilling!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Is... that so...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry. Thanks for waiting~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've been waiting~~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「So, is the park okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes♪」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lately, Lolotte has been hanging around the President's house at every opportunity.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Apparently, she plans to play with something called a telescope that she found there today...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And so, and so! How do you use this telescope?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't rush, take it easy.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The President's house really is a treasure trove, isn't it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's just a bunch of junk.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Anything packed with dreams is a treasure, no matter what. A panda stuffed with nothing but cotton wouldn't understand.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Shut up! I'm packed with love!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... that should do it. Here you go. Close one eye and take a look.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmmm~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-What on earth!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina, Amyrina. This is... amazing, hurry over here!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina, come on!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eh, ah! Y-Yes~~\s01」

name: Amyrina
message: 「There, shooting stars were reflected larger and clearer than usual.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「A sky that could never be seen in Heaven was right there.」

name: Synn
message: 「There are a lot falling this year... You can see them pretty clearly, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「From Hea――I mean, from our hometown, you can't see them at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so? I thought you could see them anywhere in the country.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「The sky... is pure white.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「An endlessly white sky... No blue sky, no clouds, no night sky, no stars--nothing at all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「E-Amyrina\s01」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It is a world without people or changing seasons.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Compared to that, this Human Wo――」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Mgggggh!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-Anyway\s01 What Amyrina wanted to say is that compared to our old life, our life now is super fun and wonderful, right, Amyrina?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Mggg--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, Amyrina is mistaken about one thing.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Mgha...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The reason I'm able to experience all these different things isn't just because we're in the Human World...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's the people we met in this land. Everyone at Ryuusei Academy, the Student Council members, and――」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's because you were here for us, President.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If all of you hadn't been here... things might have stayed just like they were back home.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's precisely why I'm so happy from the bottom of my heart to have met you all like this」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And I hope we can continue to have fun together from now on too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course! You're included in that too, Amyrina」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「First up is the Holy Night Festival!! And once the Holy Night Festival is over--」

name: Synn
message: 「There's winter break and New Year's celebrations. We still have a whole lineup of fun things ahead」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmm~~\s04 I'm already looking forward to it so much~~\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come to think of it, Mr. President! I heard shooting stars have a wonderful legend attached to them」

name: Synn
message: 「More of an anecdote than a legend, really. It's the one where if you chant your wish three times while a shooting star is shining, that wish will come true」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh! Let's try it right away!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I will too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, Amyrina, let's do it together」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-Yes」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Did we make it in time!?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「*Fluster, fluster*. W-Which shooting star are we talking about?」

name: Synn
message: 「With this many falling, at least one of them probably worked out」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ufufu. Then we're all set. What kind of wishes did the two of you make?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? Um, w-well, that's... uh...\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What's the matter? You're both being awfully vague」

name: Synn
message: 「You know, family safety, good health first. Ahahahaha\s02」

name: Amyrina
message: 「W-What about you, Lolotte? What did you wish for?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why, that's obviously--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I hope I can stay together with everyone forever from now on」
